activity: Work the scheduled appliance repair, testing the machine methodically and checking the hidden fault with the multimeter and screwdriver set. Drink water during a short break and keep the customer updated without losing track of the symptoms.

Eat the packed lunch at the service vehicle, then review the appliance symptoms in my pocket notebook. Call the customer back to answer one more question and decide what additional test or part is needed.

Continue the repair after the hidden fault and the customer's additional questions extend the appointment. Test the machine again, explain the result, clean up my tools, and document the work before driving home.
